caption:
NotebookLM quietly became Gemini Notebook in July. Same tool, same notebooks — but it just picked up a feature worth knowing about if you buy business books and never get past chapter three.

Expert Intelligence lets you add an ebook you own from Google Play Books as a grounded source, alongside your own client notes. Ask it to apply the book's framework to a real situation, and it cites the exact page.

It only works with select titles bought through Play Books — not PDFs, not library copies. Save this for the next book you buy for a specific client problem.

Follow @leverageai.daily — one AI workflow a day for people who run their own business.
